description: Search Quora through a public index, expand related questions, and export question, answer, profile, author, and topic rows. Direct URLs and usernames work without search.

answerSortOrder.description: Keep Quora's order, sort by explicit upvotes, or sort by the answer creation timestamp.
answerSortOrder.title: Answer Order

directUrls.description: Question, answer, profile, or topic URLs. Language subdomains are accepted. Comma-separated or one URL per line.
directUrls.title: Direct Quora URLs

expandRelatedQuestions.description: Open related questions linked from each question page. Quora exposes up to 70, which is how keyword search reaches more than its first result.
expandRelatedQuestions.title: Expand Related Questions

filterAiAnswers.description: Include all answers, drop answers Quora explicitly labels as AI, or keep only those labelled answers.
filterAiAnswers.title: AI Answers

includeAnswerHtml.description: Include a rendered HTML version of each answer beside its plain text. Turn off to reduce dataset size.
includeAnswerHtml.title: Include Answer HTML

includeAnswers.description: Expand question pages into answer rows. Turn off to keep question rows only.
includeAnswers.title: Include Answers

includeAuthorProfiles.description: Open each discovered author's profile to add follower, answer, question, view, and join-date fields. Turn off to keep author rows from answer evidence only.
includeAuthorProfiles.title: Enrich Authors with Profiles

includeFieldEvidence.description: Include field_sources and fields_present provenance maps on each row.
includeFieldEvidence.title: Include Field Evidence

includeProfileSensitiveFields.description: Include location, employment, education, and join date on profile and author rows when Quora shows them.
includeProfileSensitiveFields.title: Include Profile Details

includeSocialLinks.description: Include website and social links from a profile's public bio when present.
includeSocialLinks.title: Include Social Links

maxAnswersPerQuestion.description: Answers to collect from each question, including the 3-5 already visible on the page. Zero means no answers.
maxAnswersPerQuestion.title: Maximum Answers per Question

maxAuthors.description: Maximum unique author rows to emit when author is included in Result Types.
maxAuthors.title: Maximum Authors

maxItems.description: Maximum question, answer, profile, author, topic, and search-result rows across the run. Status and manifest rows do not count.
maxItems.title: Maximum Rows

maxQuestionsPerQuery.description: Hard cap on question rows for each search query, including seed and related questions.
maxQuestionsPerQuery.title: Maximum Questions per Query

maxRelatedQuestionsPerSeed.description: How many related questions to open from each question page. Zero lists the links without opening them.
maxRelatedQuestionsPerSeed.title: Related Questions per Seed

minAnswerUpvotes.description: Keep only answers with an explicit upvote count at or above this value. Answers with unknown upvotes are excluded when this is positive.
minAnswerUpvotes.title: Minimum Answer Upvotes

mode.description: Search discovers questions through the DuckDuckGo index and Quora related questions. URLs is deterministic and does not depend on search.
mode.title: Mode

onlyUnanswered.description: Keep only questions whose visible answer count is exactly zero. Questions with an unknown count are excluded.
onlyUnanswered.title: Only Unanswered Questions

resultTypes.description: Which rows to save. Status and run-manifest rows are always emitted so blocked or empty sources stay visible.
resultTypes.title: Result Types

searchQueries.description: Two to four word phrases work best. Each query finds at most a couple of question seeds, then related questions expand the result.
searchQueries.title: Search Keywords

searchTarget.description: Choose whether keyword discovery looks for question pages, profile pages, or both. Profile search is best-effort because search engines index few Quora profiles.
searchTarget.title: Search Target

usernames.description: Quora profile usernames or slugs, with or without @ or a trailing slash. Each is normalised to a profile URL.
usernames.title: Profile Usernames

title: Quora Search Scraper Input
